title: Coherence Estimation Beyond the Liouvillian Gap in a Finite Nonequilibrium System
summary: We investigate the estimation of bath-induced coherence in a finite quantum system interacting with thermal reservoirs. Enhancement of coherence estimation is transient and the estimation precision totally disappears at the steady state despite the system retaining finite coherence. By analyzing the full Liouvillian eigenspectrum, we demonstrate that the optimal sensing window emerges from the competition between identifiable contributory modes' temporal relaxation and statistical importance.
